Specification: Model-checking harness for the Voting specification. Provides finite constants for acceptors, values, quorums, ballots, and a symmetry set; defines the refinement target ConsensusSpecBar (= C!Spec); and supplies several invariants/specifications (MCInit, MCSpec, MCInv, MCSpecI) used to model-check the Voting module's safety theorems and inductive invariant.
DivisionNotes: MCInit is placed in OperatorDefNames_Init because it is named MCInit and is defined as MCInit == TypeOK, serving as the initial-state predicate for the model-checking harness.
MCInv is placed in OperatorDefNames_StatePredicate as it is a conjunction of state-level safety properties (theorems) used as a TLC invariant.
MCSpec, MCSpecI, and ConsensusSpecBar are placed in OperatorDefNames_TemporalProperty because they include the temporal operator [] (or instantiate the Spec of another module).
MCAcceptor, MCValue, MCQuorum, MCBallot, MCSymmetry are placed in OperatorDefNames_ValueDef as they define plain finite sets/values used by TLC as constant overrides.
There are no FunctionConstructor expressions, so both ByDomain and SetType partitions are empty.
There are no UNCHANGED expressions in this module.
TemporalNesting is false: top-level uses of [] do not nest other temporal operators.
VerificationTools includes TLC because the module EXTENDS the TLC tooling module and is explicitly a model-checking harness.
